confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied context (small oasis town near Ica, Peru, heavily visited for dune buggy tours and backpacker lodging); no city-price web search was performed and no live listings were inspected. Restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence. Hostel and hotel anchors are lower confidence because tourist-area accommodation prices vary a lot by season and property. Accommodation anchors include the 18% IGV tax and assume July 2026 is a shoulder period, not peak summer. Cocktail (pisco sour) and wine were set using the local beer relationship because direct price knowledge is weaker. FX: the RBA figure was taken from a search summary that attributed it to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA page directly, so the value and date should be checked against the official F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against small tourist towns on the Peruvian south coast and in the Ica region (for example Paracas and Huacachina-area guesthouses) and general Peruvian tourist-town restaurant pricing, with Cusco-adjacent tourist pricing used as an upper reference for restaurants and bars.
